name: Outward
heroTitle: Bridge the gap between digital campaigns and physical retail sales
heroLead: Turn everyday messaging apps into measurable, high-converting sales channels.
summary: Outward brings conversational AI, omnichannel messaging, and offline POS attribution into a single customer engagement platform that works across WhatsApp, KakaoTalk, Telegram, SMS, and more.

highlights.title: Offline POS Attribution
highlights.copy: Connect digital conversations to in-store transactions and verify campaign ROI with real-time coupon redemption.

highlights.title: AI Content and Search
highlights.copy: Generate campaign copy and assist with local discovery using grounded search and database-verified answers.

highlights.title: Resilient Delivery
highlights.copy: Route messages across channels with fallback logic, consent checks, and delivery guarantees.
